fields.description: Pulled from account_move.name — used as this row's key.
fields.label: Invoice Name

fields.description: account_move.invoice_date — used to match this invoice to the right Bahmni visit (by date range).
fields.label: Invoice Date

fields.description: Looked up from the Bahmni Patient Visit Log row for this patient_id — not from Odoo itself.
fields.label: Bahmni Registration Status

fields.description: account_move.doctor_name, resolved against res_partner — the billed invoice's own doctor reference, far more reliable than Bahmni's encounter data (most Bahmni encounters are logged under shared ward/counter accounts, not the individual doctor).
fields.label: Doctor Name

fields.description: Set once this row has been used to create/update a Patient Claim Form record. A separate, later step — not this sync — does that mapping.
fields.label: Mapped To Patient Claim Form

fields.description: total_bill − discount_amount — the net amount after discount (what the patient actually owes/paid).
fields.label: Invoice Total

fields.description: account_move.amount_total — the gross bill amount, before the discount is applied.
fields.label: Total Bill

fields.description: account_move.discount — how much was deducted from the total bill to arrive at the invoice total.
fields.label: Discount Amount

fields.description: Resolved account code + name (account_account) that the discount was posted against.
fields.label: Discount Account Head

fields.description: Same value as Invoice Total — what the patient pays, under this label for the NWP contribution split.
fields.label: Patient Contribution

fields.description: For an NWP (800033) bill: 20% of Total Bill when the patient is Tribal, else 0. For any account head NOT matched in the Other Donor Name list: the full Discount Amount, since no scheme-specific split is defined for those yet.
fields.label: Hospital Additional Contribution

fields.description: Total Bill − Patient Contribution − Hospital Additional Contribution.
fields.label: NWP Contribution

fields.description: Same value as Discount Amount, shown here only when Discount Account Head matches a donor in the Other Donor Name list.
fields.label: Other Donor Contribution

fields.description: Which donor (from the Other Donor Name list) this invoice's account head matched, when Other Donor Contribution is set.
fields.label: Other Donor Name
